items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 17 at 7:32PM EDT until October 22 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents expected.

* WHERE...Coastal Palm Beach County, Coastal Broward County and
Coastal Miami Dade County.

* WHEN...From late tonight through Thursday evening.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 17 at 2:39PM EDT until October 21 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Miami FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 30 kt and seas 8 to 13 ft
expected.

* WHERE...Biscayne Bay, Coastal waters from Deerfield Beach to
Ocean Reef FL out 20 NM and Waters from Deerfield Beach to
Ocean Reef FL from 20 to 60 NM excluding the territorial
waters of Bahamas.

* WHEN...From 2 AM Sunday to 8 PM EDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
